articles.title: Qatar GP organisers hopeful race will show world 'real situation'
articles.description: Qatar's Formula 1 grand prix is going ahead as planned this weekend, with organisers hoping the event will give fans watching around the world a clearer picture of "the real situation" in the country.

articles.title: Antonelli tops first practice ahead of Merc teammate Russell at Qatar GP
articles.description: Kimi Antonelli led George Russell to a Mercedes one-two in the opening practice session at the Qatar Grand Prix.

articles.title: Antonelli leads Russell in Qatar first practice
articles.description: World champion Kimi Antonelli heads Mercedes team-mate George Russell in first practice at the penultimate race of the season in Qatar.

articles.title: Qatar Grand Prix 2026: Race start time, how to watch, full schedule, predictions
articles.description: Formula 1 heads to Qatar for the second leg of its final triple header of the 2026 season.

articles.title: Russell: Verstappen's brutal jab 'amusing' as Brit looks to 'move on'
articles.description: George Russell has laughed off Max Verstappen's "quite amusing" put-down of him in Las Vegas, saying he is ready to move on from the latest exchange in their long-running feud.
